svg.text: InsightPilot: As-built Status of the System Architecture
Status as of November 12, 2026 · extends Figure 1 · CMPE 295A + 295B scope
DEPLOYMENT: ONE ORGANISATION · SELF-HOSTED / DOCKER COMPOSE
Clarify ambiguity; edit and approve plans
SPECIALIST AGENT TIER: ALL TASKS AND RESULTS ROUTED THROUGH ORCHESTRATOR
VERIFICATION & LINEAGE TIER: CHECKS USE SQL / COMPUTE, NEVER LLM SELF-CRITIQUE
Record query, grain, checks and skips
INTEGRATION TIER: READ-ONLY SOURCES; SEMANTIC DEFINITIONS TAKE PRECEDENCE
durable bindings, state, lineage and audit
SUMMARY: 6 of 18 CMPE 295A components done; 1 partial; 11 designed with specifications; 4 planned for CMPE 295B.
READING: Tiers, cards, arrows and technologies are unchanged from Figure 1; only the status fill, badge and specification line are added.
Specifications: runs/insightpilot/tech/deep_dives.md, tech/architecture/D01–D10 and product/ux_spec.md in the project repository.
